name: Ox-Body Technique

variants.label: One -1 and two -2 levels
variants.description: Gain one extra -1 and two extra -2 health levels.

description: Grants extra health levels. Repeatable once per dot of Endurance; each purchase grants one of three health-level packages.

name: Ghost Armor Prana
description: Enfolds his anima about his armor, granting it surreal lightness: per 3 motes spent, reduce the armor's fatigue value and mobility penalty by one point each (max reduction = permanent Essence). A fatigue value of zero means no fatigue rolls. Cannot reduce either below zero.

name: Tireless Sentinel Technique
description: Revivifies himself with Essence, acting at full strength with no penalties for sleep loss or exhaustion for a day (repeatable indefinitely). After Stamina + Endurance days of continuous use he takes one unsoakable bashing level each further day of use, which does not heal until he stops; he cannot safely reactivate until that damage heals.

name: Relentless Revenant Spirit
description: Death itself cannot stop him: if slain, his spirit rises again as a ghost. He loses his Exaltation and its powers but gains the full advantages of unlife, keeps any supernatural martial-arts Forms he knows (not more advanced techniques), and gains twice a starting ghost's Arcanoi.

name: Pain-Eating Focus
description: Understands the power of suffering: whenever she is struck in combat, roll one die per die of pre-soak damage the attack inflicts; each success restores 1 mote of Essence (up to her usual limit). Cannot harvest more than her Essence from a single attack.

name: Insensible Corpse Technique
description: On purchase choose permanent or temporary. Permanent: subtract 2 from all wound penalties (does not speed healing); cumulative, so a second purchase subtracts 4 and a third grants immunity to all but unimaginable agony. Temporary: for each mote spent, ignore one die of wound penalties for the scene (cumulative, may pre-empt future penalties). Exalted who know both forms combine them.

name: Agony-Savoring Spirit
description: Feeds on the suffering of others: whenever she slays an individual single-handedly, roll Conviction; each success restores one point of Willpower.
